reviews.author: judy b.
reviews.text: It's situated above the beautiful Oregon coast. The sites are on the smaller side for a motorcoach resort. We enjoyed our stay but the sites did not allow much privacy.

reviews.author: sara B.
reviews.text:
We had a 3-night reservation here and were really looking forward to our stay. Unfortunately, we experienced a motorhome breakdown while traveling and were delayed waiting on parts to make our coach drivable again.

We stayed in communication and provided updates throughout. While they did offer the option to arrive later or extend our stay, those options would have required us to pay additional nights and didn’t actually solve the situation.

We even offered to accept a credit and return for a future stay, and were willing to provide documentation of the repair and parts delay, but that was not an option. In the end, we were charged for the full 3-night stay despite never being able to arrive.

We understand policies are in place, but RV travel comes with unexpected mechanical issues, and flexibility in those situations is extremely important.

Based on this experience, we would likely choose a property that is more accommodating to real-world travel challenges in the future.

reviews.author: Nicholas T.
reviews.text:
I can't rate this resort low enough based on the service. I made the booking through a third party website which did not make it known that only RV's of a certain age and quality would be permitted. As Canadians, this came as a complete shock and we were left with nowhere to stay at peak season. In addition to losing our accommodations, no effort was made to reimburse or relocated us and we were out $650 for literally nothing.

This is the American stereotype manifest, small print that leads you to another small print document that has clauses buried. Just a malicious scheme that is completely outside of my understanding.

Do not book this location unless you've already got a $300,000 RV, but then again, if you've got that much invested already, who cares about losing $600.

reviews.author: Claire S.
reviews.text: This is a gorgeous RV Resort!!  We’ve come here many times over the years and the views are exceptional!  The crew keeps the grounds and common areas immaculate!  The bathrooms are spotless as well. (However one of the men’s toilets in the Clubhouse didn’t flush properly and needs to be fixed). The only complaint we have is that all restrooms don’t open until 7:30 am. They should be able to be open by 6 am at the latest. It seems many other guests felt the same way. Or keep the clubhouse restrooms open with the code 24 hours and keep the doors to the pool locked. It would certainly be a great improvement. Overall though, a fantastic place to spend at the ocean!!

reviews.author: D B.
reviews.text: If you own a class A or C coach, and we noticed class B also this trip, this is the place for you!  All of the RV sites are awesome, we particularly like the oceanfront ones, and the amenities are the best! This property is kept up perfectly at all times. People are friendly and respectful. The office staff, particularly Lisa, are amazing, helpful, fun, and make it so nice for everyone!!! We’ve stayed here about 50 times over the years and it’s better than ever, if that’s possible. We highly recommend!! The pictures are from our coach and on our walk to the beach on the private trail from the resort.

Super easy and fast check in, very nice people. Our specific site overlooked the ocean and was a 2 min walk to the beach. Great weekend!

This place was exactly as advertised. Very clean, very organized and the best views of the ocean in the drive in sites. Not a single complaint or issue. Great WiFi, and just a great facility all around. The beach was a little longer of a walk than expected, but it was worth the walk.

This RV park has a fantastic location oceanfront! The park itself has paved, concrete sites, each with a patch of grass. It is nearly all Class As and most sites look like they are lived at longer term. It is very well maintained, but not a typical camping experience if that is what you are looking for. Can’t beat the beach though!

We stayed on Lot#49 and it was amazing! Sunset every night through thru trees to the ocean, no green flash but no worries. Perfect site for an evening glass of wine and visits from local property owners. Highly recommend the resort and property.

Pacific Shores MotorCoach Resort is the best place to stay on the Oregon Coast. The staff is amazing.... especially, Lisa!!! We spent three amazing days here in our new RV and had an unexpected problem retracting our slide out. Lisa was kind, calming and gracious while we waited for a repairman. She understood our delay and went above and beyond to assist us. Pacific Shores is very well maintained, beautiful and the beach was fantastic!

Treat yourself to a stay here. Absolutely gorgeous luxurious park on the bluffs overlooking the ocean. Easy access from Route 101. Everything is impeccably maintained and the park is well designed. Staff checked us in at our coach when we arrived and then we were guided to our site. Wide, paved roads throughout. Since this is an ownership park, each site differs based on improvements made by its owner. Our site, #93, had a paved parking area and concrete patio with Adirondack chairs and picnic table, surrounded by shrubs and flower beds. No problems getting level, and all utilities worked as expected. Sites are large. Both staff and the owners in sites surrounding us were friendly. There are 2 fenced dog parks, although they are out of the way on the edges of this large park. There were some other areas for leash walking. There is a large green space in the center of the park with walking trails. There is access to a private beach. Two laundry rooms; the one closest to us was clean and well equipped. We stayed for a week and wished we had booked a longer stay. Next time we will.

We're a full-time motorhome family of four - kids 8 and 10. We own at PacShores and have been there for over a year. We rented over the past few years and had such a good experience, we decided to buy. Our kids have been welcomed by the community, and now have a "family" here. We love the amenities like the pools, easy beach access, and the kids have space to ride their bikes and scooters. There are FREE volunteer led events open to renters and owners. The grounds are well maintained, and we've never had a problem here - as renters or owners.
